title: chaerophyllum cicutaria var. alpestre
intro: Chaerophyllum cicutaria var. alpestre, commonly known as mountain parsley, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of mountain parsley include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of mountain parsley include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-infective, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties.
